description.value: MR MIKES SteakhouseCasual is a long-running Canadian chain (est. 1960) serving premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and shareable appetizers in a relaxed, no-dress-code atmosphere. The Vernon location welcomes both walk-ins and reservations, and positions itself as a neighbourhood gathering spot for locals and tourists alike. A solid option for touring cyclists seeking a full sit-down meal with a broad menu after a day on the road.

address.value: 3908 32 Street, Vernon, British Columbia, V1T 5P2, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for the Vernon location is live and confirms the OSM address (3908 32 Street, Vernon, BC V1T 5P2), phone (236-426-4436), and email (vernon@mrmikes.ca). The website explicitly offers takeout and delivery ordering. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content or OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible chain restaurant confirmed via live website. A straightforward inclusion for a cycling tourism directory.
